system.description: Toxic berries of a dark shrub. One attack each minute gives –1D to Cunning (more with degrees); another each hour gives –2D to Endurance. If penalty dice equal the ability's rank, the victim dies.
system.effects:
Virulence 4; Toxicity 2; Frequency 1/minute and 1/hour; Diagnosis Routine (6).

Toxic berries of a dark shrub. One attack each minute gives –1D to Cunning (more with degrees); another each hour gives –2D to Endurance. If penalty dice equal the ability's rank, the victim dies.
system.recovery: After it runs its course, a Challenging (9) Endurance test each week removes one penalty die per degree.
